svg.text: ENTERPRISE AI GATEWAY SELECTION: AZURE APIM VS. LITELLM VS. KONG AI VS. ENVOY AI / HIGRESS
Envoy AI Gateway / Higress (K8s Inference Extension) + Token Bucket Hits 0.9ms Proxy Tax & 120ms Failover
120-Tenant EnterpriseMaaS (1,500 RPS, 20B Tok/Mo): Tier 1 Nginx/ALB ($380K/mo) vs. Tier 2 LiteLLM vs. Tier 3 APIM/Kong vs. Tier 4 ($136K/mo)
⛔ Why Traditional L7 Gateways (Nginx/ALB) Fail on LLMs
1. Request-Count (`RPM`) vs. Weighted Token (`TPM`) Blindness:
• Counting `1 HTTP POST = 1 unit` lets a single 128K-context
agent request consume `256x` the GPU capacity of a 500-tok chat!
2. SSE Streaming Blindness & 60s Timeout Freezes:
• Output token counts arrive only in the final SSE `usage` chunk;
waiting 60s on stalled upstreams blocks PTU->PAYGO failover!
3. Stateless Round-Robin Destroys vLLM KV Cache Affinity:
• Lacks K8s Gateway API Inference Extension `KV/LoRA` metrics
Tier 1 Traditional L7 Proxy Failure Impact (20B Tok/Mo):
• Noisy-Tenant Quota Breach Rate: 44.5% (PTU starvation!)
• Outage / 429 Failover Recovery: 60,000 ms (60s timeout)
• Monthly Platform TCO: $380,000 / month
🏆 4-Way AI Gateway Selection & Token Bucket Math
1. Two-Phase Token Rate Limiting (`Pre-Flight Reserve + SSE Reconcile`):
• Reserves `N_in + E[N_out]` pre-flight; reconciles exact `N_in +`
`w_out * N_out` from the final SSE chunk in Redis in `<0.5ms`!
2. Clear 4-Product Selection Boundary:
• `Azure APIM`: Best for Azure PTU + Entra ID | `LiteLLM`: Best
100+ model SDK & FinOps UI | `Kong AI`: Hybrid enterprise API
• `Envoy AI Gateway / Higress`: Best K8s vLLM KV/LoRA data plane!
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks (Envoy AI / Higress):
• P99 Proxy Latency Overhead: 0.9 ms | 429/TTFT Failover: 120 ms
• Noisy-Tenant Quota Breach Rate: 0.0% (Strict Weighted TPM)
• Monthly 20B-Token Platform TCO: $136,000 / mo (-64.2% savings)
